On which date did the Commission actually adopt the first implementing act with the template for Member States' data collection provided for in Article 6(10) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230?

response.text: On what date did the Commission in fact adopt the first implementing act containing the template for Member States' data collection under Article 6(10) of Regulation (EU) 2023/1230?
